profile.name: Jemimah Rodrigues
profile.writeup:
Long before lit stadium towers illuminated her strokeplay on the international stage, Jemimah Rodrigues honed her wristy athleticism on the concrete fields of Bandra, Mumbai. Dual-talented in both field hockey and cricket, her footwork at the crease carries the light, darting agility of a hockey forward evading defenders in tight spaces. She bats with animated joy, her light blade dancing through the arc to turn sharp bowling into cheekily placed boundaries through backward point and mid-wicket, injecting infectious vitality into India's batting order every time she steps past the boundary rope.


Emerging into the national side in 2018 at just seventeen years old, Rodrigues quickly established her place as a vital tactical pivot in India's top and middle order. Her game is constructed on soft hands, elite athletic running between the wickets, and an exceptional ability to manipulate field placements without resorting to high-risk slogging. She signalled her international calibre early in her debut year by scoring a memorable half-century against South Africa in intra-continental conditions, proving her readiness for top-flight international pressure as a teenager.


Her international trajectory is punctuated by defining big-match performances in high-stakes global tournaments. Whether orchestrating a thrilling run-chase against Pakistan at the 2023 T20 World Cup or holding the innings together during tight knockout fixtures, her temperament shines brightest when national expectations peak. Beyond her international duties, she established herself as a foundational cornerstone and leadership presence for Delhi Capitals in the Women's Premier League, while also enjoying successful stints in top-flight overseas franchise leagues.


A key architect of India's silver medal performance at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, her finest hour came during India's historic 2025 ICC Women's ODI World Cup triumph, anchored by her heroic, match-winning century under severe knockout pressure. Coupled with India's gold medal victory at the 2023 Asian Games, that World Cup campaign permanently enshrined her legacy in Indian sporting folklore. Beyond her athletic achievements, Rodrigues represents the vibrant, uninhibited spirit of modern Indian women's sport, combining world-class discipline with a joyful approach that continues to inspire young athletes across the country.
